newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices fall trailing lower natural gas.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices fall trailing lower natural gas.

text.p: Wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) fell off Tuesday, trailing lower natural gas physical prices in the state, industry sources said.
Spot natural gas prices in Texas were reported to generally have fallen about 10 cents on Tuesday to near $2.50 per million British thermal units on southern Texas pipelines.
Traders cited mild weather in Texas and the East Coast as driving the gas prices down.
Electricity prices followed the short-term gas lower.
Although prices prices began the day strong, peak, firm power for Wednesday delivery fell to a bid/ask range of $25.00-26.50 in the afternoon from $27.00-29.00 on Monday, brokers and marketers said.
Off peak ERCOT power for Wednesday delivery was pegged steady at $13.00-15.00, the sources said.
December peak power was also talked steady at $24.25-24.75, while January/February ERCOT power was said to be offered at $25.00, down from a bid/ask range of $25.25-25.50 on Monday, the sources said.
Temperatures in Texas were forecast to be above normal from Nov 10 to 14.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
